newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE MADE HONORARY CITIZEN OF HENGELO.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE MADE HONORARY CITIZEN OF HENGELO.

text.p: Haile Gebrselassie of Ethiopia has been made an honourary citizen of the Dutch town of Hengelo following his new world best for two miles here on Saturday.
Gebrselassie has been nicknamed 'Mr Hengelo' by the local population because of his annual attempts to set world best times at the Fanny Blankers Koen Stadium in the town.
In 1995 he set a world best for 10,000 metres at the Grand Prix meeting there.

However he dismissed suggestions that he would be following in the footsteps of his elder brother Tekeye, who has been given political asylum in the Netherlands and is considering seeking Dutch citizenship.
"I will always run for Ethiopia," said Gebrselassie in Hengelo on Sunday.
